name: Kokum
description: Dark sour rind from the Konkan coast, soaked for sol kadhi and curries.

ayurveda.note: Vrikshamla is one of the few sour dravyas classed as shita, and is given specifically against heat and thirst.

unani.note: Thanda and astringent; the coastal summer drink is built on it.

histamine.note: Very sour, so flagged with the other sour fruits, though it is used in small amounts.
